In [[mathematics]], a '''connector''' is a map which can be defined for a [[Connection (vector bundle)|linear connection]] and used to define the [[covariant derivative]] on a [[vector bundle]] from the linear connection.
 
== Definition ==
Let ∇ be a connection on the tangent space TN of a smooth manifold N. For smooth mappings h:M→TN from any smooth manifold M, the connector K:TTN→TN satisfies : [[Nabla symbol|∇]] h = K○Th:TM→TN where Th:TM→TTN is the differential of h.
